IRS990.Desc: THE VEBA IS A JOINT LABOR-MGMT ASSOC OF PARTICIPANT DISTRICTS IN CALIFORNIA. THE VEBA PROVIDES INSURANCE COVERAGE TO NEARLY 150,000 EMPLOYEES, RETIREES & DEPENDENTS OF THE MEMBER DISTRICTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES GENERALLY ACCEPTED IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA REQUIRE MANAGEMENT TO EVALUATE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN BY VEBA AND RECOGNIZE A TAX LIABILITY (OR ASSET) IF IT HAS TAKEN AN UNCERTAIN POSITION THAT MORE LIKELY THAN NOT WOULD NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY THE IRS. VEBA IS SUBJECT TO ROUTINE AUDITS BY TAXING JURISDICTIONS; HOWEVER, THERE ARE CURRENTLY NO AUDITS FOR ANY TAX PERIODS IN PROGRESS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CALIFORNIA SCHOOL VEBA DELEGATES ADMISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT TO RISK PROGRAM ADMISTRATOR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS CONSISTS OF SIX BOARD MEMBERS THAT ARE APPOINTED BY THE MANAGEMENT, WHICH IS ANY SAN DIEGO COUNTY PUBLIC SCHOOL DISTRICT OR COMMUNITY COLLEGE, AND THE SAN DIEGO COUNTY OFFICE OF EDUCATION ENTERING INTO A COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEGEMENT WITH A UNION (MANAGEMENT DIRECTORS). SIX BOARD MEMBERS ARE APPOINTED BY THE PARTICIPATING LABOR UNIONS. THERE ARE TWO ALTERNATE LABOR DIRECTORS AND TWO ALTERNATE MANAGEMENT DIRECTORS. IN ADDITION, THERE ARE TWO MANAGEMENT SELECTED BOARD MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE VEBA'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE UPON THE REQUEST OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND/OR INDIVIDUAL MEMBER DISTRICTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VII, SECTION A, COLUMN (E)
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE TRUST MADE A REASONABLE EFFORT TO OBTAIN THE AMOUNT OF COMPENSATION PAID BY RELATED ORGANIZATIONS TO TRUSTEES BY DISTRIBUTING A QUESTIONNAIRE TO EACH OF ITS TRUSTEES AND FOLLOWING UP WITH NON-RESPONDING TRUSTEES. COMPENSATION INFORMATION RECEIVED BY THE TRUST FROM RESPONDING TRUSTEES IS REPORTED ON FORM 990, PART VII, SECTION A, COLUMN (E).
